_comment: GATED, mechanism 1 of 3: bloodline_ascensions, the veteran gate (D18 tier B, the count that rides the play ticket). Thematically the line that has laid down three lives learns to make the world flinch back. ⚑ It is also Hoarfrost's second ingredient, so this entry is the one that makes the catalog's combination reachable from inside the catalog.
